{{Top|leg}}
A '''decicred-dreadful''' was a children's publication, usually in parts, with each part costing a [[Decicred/Legends|decicred]]. This allowed children to be able to afford stories without having to purchase an entire work. Some works fictionalized stories of settlers fighting [[Alien/Legends|alien]] raiders and their [[Hutt/Legends|Huttese]] counterparts in the expansion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].

==Behind the scenes==
The term is analogous to the real-world term "[[Wikipedia:penny dreadful|penny dreadful]]."
